caption: A masked guest ring announcer at Winter Inferno 97 (15 December 1997) who got caught up in the tag title brawl.

name: Bermuda

tenures.note: Manager of Sabre and Sledge Hammer, Pain and Suffering. Appears in the segments of Thursday Night Titans (6 February 1997). The page pairs Bermuda and Sabre and Sledge Hammer: named as their manager ("Sabre and Sledge Hammer, along with their manager Bermuda").

caption: Pain and Suffering's manager at Thursday Night Titans (6 February 1997).

name: Sunshine

tenures.note: Manager of Tommy Van Rock. Appears in the segments of Ground Zero (28 June 1997). The page pairs Sunshine and Tommy Van Rock: named as his manager ("Van Rock's manager...Sunshine...just threw powder in Temple's eyes").

caption: Tommy Van Rock's manager at Ground Zero (28 June 1997).
